title: Appenzell Ausserrhoden legal aid appeal

matter.description: Appeal against denial of legal aid before the Obergericht Appenzell Ausserrhoden. Issues include Art. 56 ZPO, economic capacity, bank records, advance on costs and whether transfers between accounts of the same applicant were counted twice.

facts.description: Applicant requested legal aid for a civil proceeding.
Lower authority denied legal aid based on asserted economic capacity.
Applicant alleged that a Bank A current-account statement was provided.
Applicant alleged that an own transit savings account was used only as a temporary transfer account before transfer to Bank B.
Applicant alleged transfer from Bank A to the transit savings account and then to Bank B, with no duplicate assets.
Applicant disputes a possible treatment of the transit savings account as a third additional asset account.
Final transit-account balance is material but not confirmed in the local fixture.
